items.title: A bounded inverse system of Artinian algebras has a limit in the completed category, with the kernels inducing the adic topology

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a sequence of surjective maps of Artinian algebras whose relative cotangent dimensions are bounded has a limit in the completed category, and that the kernels of the projections define its adic topology (statement lines 1277-1285). The proof (proof lines 1287-1313) stabilizes the cotangent dimensions to build a compatible polynomial presentation, completes the polynomial ring and applies the topology lemma to identify the limit and its topology. H2: a three-step construction with two inputs, written out in full.
